noah (sec-eng): quick sync: we're seeing an increase in image scan failures for the runtime base images that power the key-management services. Most alerts point at outdated libcurl/OpenSSL patches. This coincided with yesterday's baseimage rebase.

riley (infra): Which images and which registry?

noah (sec-eng): registry.redwood.com/runtime/base:20260318 -> scanner flagged CVE-2026-EE11 against libcurl and CVE-2026-FF22 in openssl. Full report in drive: https://redwood.app/drive/driveid/base-scan-20260320

toni (runtime): We rolled a base rebase last night to pick up kernel tooling. Did that rebase also pull in older distro packages?

riley (infra): The rebase switched distros from slim-bullseye to slim-bookworm to pick up glibc fixes, but some backports were incomplete. I'm going to hold the rebase pipeline and tag the images as 'hold-until-scan'

sam (compliance): Hold until cosign signed + CVE triage complete. Also ensure the rebuild process includes KMS key reference in the pipeline so we can verify signatures via HSM-backed keys.

deploy-bot: tag applied: runtime/base:20260318 -> runtime/base:hold-20260321 by riley at 2026-03-21T09:12:03Z

noah (sec-eng): Can we carve a temporary mitigation? patch openssl in the image and re-run cosign. Toni, owner for rebuild?

toni (runtime): I can trigger a targeted rebuild of the logship and key-rotation images with patched libs. Will require infra to provide build nodes with KMS signing access and compliance approval before cosign step.

audit-bot: recorded artifact: image-scan-report/runtime-base-20260318.json at 2026-03-21T09:15:00Z

riley (infra): I'll provision ephemeral builders with limited KMS sign permissions and add a build step that performs `openssl version` check and `apt-get update` before packaging.

noah (sec-eng): Add to rebuild checklist: 1) cosign sign with KMS key; 2) record the key fingerprint in PR; 3) run container-scan and fail on high/critical; 4) run a canary container that executes a KMS PutObject test against a staging bucket.

sam (compliance): Also require a manifest that lists CVEs and the patch/upgrade plan for each. That should be in the PR description.

riley (infra): Opening infra#6120 to automate the 'hold-until-scan' tagging and to gate the rebase pipeline on a successful scan + cosign.

toni (runtime): ETA for targeted rebuilds: 2 hours after infra nodes up. Will coordinate with compliance to get KMS signing access.

noah (sec-eng): Good. Once rebuilt and cosigned, let's run the rewrap backfill for the windows we missed. Queue job to re-encrypt and re-ingest those missing artifacts.

(End of thread)
